items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Amos and I played together. We played the St. Louis Blues.

ctx.x: I played, I think it was a couple of tunes, not too many, because I played on Amos horn. And the second time that I attended one of these sessions is Amos, they gave Amos a plaque of some kind, an award. It was at the Claremont Hotel in Oakland. And I didn't have a horn. And that time, a guy loaned me his cornet, and Amos and I played together. We played the St. Louis Blues.
